code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and 0 < r < h - 1:
            color = row[0]
            candidates.append((sum(x == color for line in grid for x in line), "h", r))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and 0 < c < w - 1:
            color = grid[0][c]
            candidates.append((sum(row[c] == color for row in grid), "v", c))
    _, orient, k = min(candidates)
    if orient == "h":
        a, b = grid[:k], grid[k + 1:]
        return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(a))]
    a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
    b = [row[k + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a[r][c] != 0 and b[r][c] != 0 else 0 for c in range(k)] for r in range(h)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(code)
